name: JV_ACCOUNTING_HEADERS
description: This table contains accounting header information for transactions generated within Joint Venture Management for internal transfers, partner contribution transfers, carried interest journals, and allocations.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the accounting header.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Accounting reference document number.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The type code to identify the type of accounting transaction. It is based on the ORA_JV_ACCOUNTING_TYPE lookup codes such as Internal Transfer, Partner Contribution Transfer, Allocation, and so forth.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture that is associated with the accounting transaction.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that is associated with the accounting transaction.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the carried interest agreement that is associated with the accounting transaction.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the partner contribution that is associated with the accounting transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date that will be sent to subleger accounting.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code to identify the state of the accounting transaction. It is based on the ORA_JV_ACCOUNTING_STATUS lookup codes such as Available to Process, Process Complete, and so forth.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class. This is referenced from XLA_EVENTS table.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger as defined in general ledger.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
